device.type: Full HD DVB-S2 / DVB-T / DVB-C receiver with CA, CI, VFD and Ethernet
device.board: 0A010A00 (Fulansoft / Synaps ALi M3606A Lemontree EuP platform, stb_board_type = 1)
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x60

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko (1.7.10 EMU)
source.note: Archive AMIKO_HD8300_Series_1.7.10_emu.zip from the Amiko/Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602-family board with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_hd8300_series_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8300_series_capture_screen.py): under 0x3603 the "M3606A 1.1.3" bootloader maps the 8 MB flash in the 16 MB window at 0xAF000000, prints "APP  init ok", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E8F9B8, exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM frames (" ON " -> "    ") with the Lemontree EuP standby and front-panel MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 103 (SCL) / 102 (SDA), and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80000200.  The application starts "M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200 (EBase 0x80000000 / 0x80000001), updates the Lemontree panel to " on ", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 ("stb_tuner_type = 1, stb_board_type =1."), and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog (9 GE commands, 30 colours).

desc: Amiko HD8300 Series (System ID 0A010A00) firmware 1.7.10 EMU (2016-10-26) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3606A / C3603 Full HD receiver with VFD.

Pairs dual-CPU M3606 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200) with a Lemontree EuP standby and front-panel MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 103 / 102 (" ON " -> " on "), ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
